title: Pakistan arrested fisherman who was 'spying' for India, claims minister
description: IISLAMABAD, Nov 1:  Pakistan’s Information Minister Attaullah Tarar on Saturday claimed that a fisherman from the country has been arrested for allegedly spying for India.
